FAQ
How do I extend my rental? ▾
Go to Rentals, select the item and tap "Extend". You can extend up to 7 days before the return date.
What if a tool breaks during use? ▾
Contact Customer service immediately. Normal wear is covered; damage from misuse may incur a fee.
What's in the Basic kit? ▾
Power drill, spirit level, caulking gun and stud finder — everything for a typical weekend job at €20/day.
How does the AI assistant work? ▾
The AI uses Claude to understand your job and recommend the right tools. Video mode lets you show a problem live. One-time unlock — €4.99 after the 7-day trial.
What payment methods are accepted? ▾
Visa, Mastercard, iDEAL, PayPal, and bank transfer. Manage under Delivery & returns.
